the-twisted.name: The Crooked
the-twisted.description: Five rounds follow the same six-movement asymmetric sequence, including a linked Romanian Deadlift-to-Clean passage.

the-descent.name: The Descent
the-descent.description: Long Cycle climbs from one to ten as Renegade Row descends from ten to one across ten rungs.

the-rite.name: The Rite
the-rite.description: Each round binds a four-movement chain, separates its movements into a complex, then restores the chain.

labyrinth-ladder.name: The Labyrinth Ladder
labyrinth-ladder.description: Double Snatch and Double Thruster climb from one to ten, then descend across nineteen rungs.

abyss-carry.name: The Abyss Carry
abyss-carry.description: Five rounds carry double-bell lifts through a fifty-step Front Rack Carry.

iron-ascent.name: The Iron Ascent
iron-ascent.description: A single-side ladder gives way to left-then-right single-bell work, then a double-bell finish.

sections.label: Phase II — Single Kettlebell · Left Side, Then Right Hand

everlasting-cycle.name: The Everlasting Cycle
everlasting-cycle.description: Five rounds repeat the same five-movement sequence without separating one movement from the whole.

web-of-motion.name: The Web of Motion
web-of-motion.description: Six movements return in the same order across five rounds, each transition part of Arachne’s web.

the-final-trial.name: The Final Trial
the-final-trial.description: One complete round from every monster you have already conquered, in order, with rest between each. There is no second attempt within the hunt — only forward.

hell-dive.name: Hell-Dive
hell-dive.description: Three moves, five rounds, no time to think. Swing, snatch, thruster — hit it hard and get out before it hits back.

atlas-chain.name: The Sovereign's Chain
atlas-chain.description: Six rounds repeat one five-movement Double Chain, three repetitions per movement.

ember-trial.name: The Ember Trial
ember-trial.description: Three rounds pair seven double-bell movements with a fifty-step Double Farmer Carry.

endless-grind.name: The Endless Grind
endless-grind.description: Five rounds move through double-bell work, single-side sequences, and switching swings.

final-second.name: The Final Second
final-second.description: Five exercises, one minute each, four times through. The window does not wait for the last rep.

mirror-trial.name: The Mirror Trial
mirror-trial.description: Left side, then right — the same thirty seconds of work, twice over, five times through. No side gets to skip its turn.

twin-assault.name: The Twin Assault
twin-assault.description: One head from above, one from the ground. Five rounds each, and neither head is the easy one.

unbroken-cycle.name: The Unbroken Cycle
unbroken-cycle.description: Five left-and-right pairs repeat the same three-movement chain from the floor.

twin-engine.name: The Twin Engine
twin-engine.description: Five rounds rotate through alternating actions, paired lifts, rows, swings, and a fifty-step carry.

living-current.name: The Unbroken Chain
living-current.description: One continuous alternating-hand chain repeats for five rounds, one movement at a time.

iron-descent.name: The Risen
iron-descent.description: Two passes through a five-movement chain give way to the same movements performed as a complex.

war-engine.name: The Breaking
war-engine.description: Fifteen rounds repeat the same three-movement sequence.

endless-spiral.name: The Wraith
endless-spiral.description: Each round carries the same five linked movements through the left hand, then the right.

mammoth-emom.name: Mammoth Complex
mammoth-emom.description: Five kettlebell movements return against the three-minute round window for five rounds.

basilisk-confrontation.name: Basilisk Confrontation
basilisk-confrontation.description: Burpee, Double Long-Cycle sequences, Double Deadlift, and Double Long-Hike Snatch return in the same six-part order for five rounds.

judge-verdict.name: The Judge's Verdict
judge-verdict.description: Five rounds follow the same six-movement double-bell chain, with the handover lunge counted for each leg.

ravager-assault.name: The Ravager
ravager-assault.description: Five sets repeat the nine-movement sequence: Burpee, Clean, Jerk, Deadlift, Clean, Jerk, Deep Snatch, Clean, Jerk, with the authored 4-2-2 pattern.
